decision: Initial specialization regresses; native evidence motivates one bounded-integer follow-up.
observedNativeIssue: Loop backedge includes Float64-to-int32 round-trip equality/NaN guards. Those guard instructions take 4280 ticks in the dominant body. This identifies emitted work, not an individual instruction latency.
nextExperiment: Constrain chunk-local cursors and limits to int32: calculate validates chunk size <= 2^28 and buffers reserve only 256 lookahead bytes, so every valid cursor fits. Verify conversion guards disappear and rerun correctness and timing.
